messages:
maria: Pushed a new model-compare dashboard for canary vs stable. Link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/model-compare-v2
kevin: Looking at it — I see a ~2ms tail increase on v2 for long sequences (>1024). Kernel selector is falling back to an fp16->fp32 path at step ~1100.
sam: Also observed KV cache miss spikes aligned with those traces. Batch sizes dropped to 1-2 during the window, amplifying per-token overhead.
li: Can we get a flamegraph? I pulled trace trace-0x9abf from the profiler. Top ops:
```
# perf sample summary
AttentionKV::lookup 35.1%
KernelSelect::choose 17.8% (fallback path)
quant_dispatch 8.2%
```
ops-bot: canary-deploy: model=v2.3-canary started on fleet-us-west-2 at 2026-03-18T14:12:00Z
maria: @kevin can you check the kernel configmap? My hunch: selector thresholds are off for variable seq shapes and prefix-cache accounting inflates effective seq_len.
kevin: quick check: configmap kernel_pref: ["q8","q4","fp16"], fallback_threshold_tokens: 1024. I think fallback triggers because prefix cache reports prefix_len incorrectly for routed requests.
sam: I'll try increasing accumulation_ms by +3ms for routes chat-small and docs-embed to see if batch sizes stabilize. Also we need a dashboard panel for batch-size distribution per-route.
li: will run the flamegraph+trace aggregation and attach results here. ETA ~2h.
maria: If p99 token latency for v2 canary > 200ms for 2m, we should auto-roll back. Can someone add an alert for that?
kevin: added alert rule infra.latency.token_p99{model=v2_canary} > 200ms for 2m -> notify #eng-oncall
sam: also adding kernel-variant breakdown panel (kernel_pref + route) to the model-compare dashboard.
maria: thanks all — ping with any trace ids or quick findings. :thumbsup:
